history.note: needs missing engine capability: Gangplank Naval (ven-181-166) has NO parsed Empowered replacement ability at all, and there is no replacement call site for 'would modify my Might' — effects/swap-might.ts and modify-might.ts write meta.mightModifier directly without consulting checkReplacement. Fix needs (1) explicit replacement abilities in data/sets/ven.json gated while-empowered covering stun/-Might/return-to-hand, (2) a new replaces:'modify-might' event checked in a shared applyMightModifier helper used by swap-might + modify-might. Out of scope for one iteration.
